name: The River at Rancho Mirage
summary: Large outdoor destination along an artificial river featuring shops, restaurants & a movie theater.
description: The River at Rancho Mirage is an open-air lifestyle destination featuring a curated mix of stores, restaurants, a movie theatre, and entertainment venues along Highway 111 in the heart of the Coachella Valley. With regular events including live talent performances and Battle of the Bands competitions, this center offers a vibrant gathering place for both shopping and community entertainment.
demographics: The River attracts affluent visitors and residents of the Coachella Valley, including wealthy retirees, seasonal residents, and tourists drawn to the Palm Springs area. The primary trade area serves upper-middle to high-income households with significant discretionary spending power, particularly empty nesters and mature adults aged 45+ who appreciate upscale casual dining and entertainment. The center also captures a secondary market of younger professionals and families seeking lifestyle-oriented shopping and dining experiences in a resort-style outdoor setting.
